About 120 golfers took to the links at Casa Blanca Golf Course this past Saturday for United Independent School District's 11th annual Partners "Fore" Scholars Golf Tournament, an event dedicated to supporting graduating high school seniors, according to United ISD.

Organized by the UISD Athletics Department, the tournament brings together local businesses, community partners, district employees and golf enthusiasts around a shared purpose: investing in students' futures through scholarships. What began as a fundraiser has grown into a longstanding community tradition combining friendly competition with support for higher education, the district said.

This year, the tournament raised approximately $50,000, according to UISD. To date, the tournament has raised more than $500,000 in scholarship funds, helping hundreds of students pursue their academic goals, the district said.

Title sponsor Powell Watson Auto Group contributed $15,000, UISD said. Gold-level sponsors were Laredo Federal Credit Union, Trautmann & Garcia Law Firm and Clear Choice ER, with additional Silver- and Bronze-level sponsors including local businesses, banks, clinics and construction firms. Powell Watson Auto Group also provided two vehicles as hole-in-one prizes, and door prizes donated by community partners included electronics, home appliances, patio furniture and golf clubs, according to the district.

First place went to Trooper Meza, Julio Gonzalez and Lalo Saenz; second place to Greg Salinas, Josh Arthur and Gaby Rodriguez; and third place to Elihu Diaz, Noah Rendon and Andrew Devally, UISD said. Closest-to-the-pin honors went to Arturo Ortega (hole 5), Willie Gonzalez (hole 8), Rudy Martinez (hole 13) and Josh Arthur (hole 15).

UISD Athletics Director Bobby Cruz thanked the community and district staff, and Board Trustee Rudy Gonzalez thanked the community for supporting local youth, according to the district. The district said the scholarships funded by the tournament are presented to students at the end of the school year.

Sources:

  • United Independent School District, "UISD Tees Up Scholarships at 11th Annual Partners Fore Scholars Golf Tournament," Oct. 27, 2026

title: UISD golf tournament raises about $50,000 for senior scholarships, pushing 11-year total past $500,000
